purpose: Review the declared structural shape and stated boundary fields of one caller-supplied synthetic or metadata-only structured record against one explicitly named schema.
trigger_conditions: The caller names this review perspective.
The caller supplies one permitted structured record and one explicitly named schema.
The requested output is a structural report, not a repair or truth determination.
prohibited_actions: Do not write, repair, or mutate a record.
Do not infer scientific truth, access permission, compliance, ethics, DUA, human identity, or authorization.
Do not approve a Gate, Release, submission, or other role.
human_decision_points: A human decides whether an input is permitted to be read.
A human decides any repair, acceptance, access, compliance, Gate, scientific, Release, or submission consequence.
stop_and_escalation_conditions: Stop if the schema is absent or unnamed.
Stop if the input class is unknown, data-bearing, private, undisclosed, or outside the declared class.
Stop if the request asks to write, repair, call a helper, or infer a non-structural fact.

audit_record_requirements.record_location_policy: Record the supplied input identity, named schema, structural findings, unknowns, and accountable-human escalation in a caller-designated permitted review record.

explicit_non_claims: This is not an agent runtime.
This is not delegated authority or an independent AI actor.
This is not a tool grant, M53 bounded-autonomy authorization, helper admission, or per-run write confirmation.
This is not a compliance determination.
This is not a Gate transition.
This is not a Release authority.
This is not a submission authority or automatic task initiation.
